target_claim: The displayed unweighted ℓ² formula defines a metric d₂ on all of the Hilbert cube I^ω.
source_quote: where $d_2$ is the [[Definition:Metric|metric]]: $\ds \forall x = \sequence {x_i}, y = \sequence {y_i} \in I^\omega: \map {d_2} {x, y} := \paren {\sum_{k \mathop \in \N_{>0} } \paren {x_k - y_k}^2}^{\frac 1 2}$
